name: Mother's Children
description: Mother’s Children are individuals brought forth through or associated with the Mother’s Prayer. Gerk is explicitly identified as one of Mother’s children, indicating that the designation applies to him directly. Juten Prime and Plymouth expected the appearance of one of Mother’s children to supersede their previous preparations, suggesting that these individuals hold particular significance within the events surrounding the Mother’s Prayer.
